items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: Teddy Wilson, the great pianist whose centennial is this year on the 24th of November, 1912, he used to call them “spare parts.”

ctx.x: An alto sax player kid, he’s about 24. Unbelievable. I did a gig with him when he was 17. In any case yeah, the spare parts. Teddy Wilson, the great pianist whose centennial is this year on the 24th of November, 1912, he used to call them “spare parts.” Where you’d be playing a song and all of a sudden you’d hear [scats] and it’s sneaking in there. It’s a joke. It’s a little jest. It’s a little sneaky thing that, it fits. Some people force/impose them and go out of their way to put in something silly.
